summary: Health Payment Systems, Inc., a healthcare technology and billing services company, suffered a data breach involving unauthorized access to its email systems that exposed sensitive information for approximately 9,380 individuals. The breach was reported to the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Compromised data includes names, Social Security numbers, medical information, and health insurance details. Federman & Sherwood is investigating whether the company implemented adequate cybersecurity safeguards to protect the protected health information entrusted to its care.
